name: LOAD-OWED-streams-alone
old: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => built.has(`${x},${y}`) || !state.loaded.has(`${x},${y}`), uc.owed);
new: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => !StreamingWorldState.streams(x, y) || built.has(`${x},${y}`), uc.owed);
note: The count asks only whether the world streams there (ETHER-OW's line): a pixel whose build threw reads loading to the end, and the journey is held at x1 until the next pixel crossed - the report.

name: LOAD-OWED-books-unread
old: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => built.has(`${x},${y}`) || !state.loaded.has(`${x},${y}`), uc.owed);
new: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => built.has(`${x},${y}`), uc.owed);
note: Every pixel not built is owed: the failed one holds the clock, and where the world streams nothing the land is waited on for ever.

name: LOAD-OWED-nothing-owed
old: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => built.has(`${x},${y}`) || !state.loaded.has(`${x},${y}`), uc.owed);
new: uc.n = unbuiltAround(px, radius, (x, y) => true, uc.owed);
note: The land never holds the clock: the journey outruns a grid still building (TV2's hole in the world).

name: LOAD-OWED-failed-kept-on-the-books
new: state.failed.set(`${next.px},${next.py}`, { px: next.px, py: next.py, tries: 1, at: Infinity });
note: The pump keeps a pixel whose build threw on the stream's books: owed by nobody building it, the hold never lets go.
